events: What if every step you took was three times longer than the last?
Tuesday. Dale is late for the bus.
Six meters. Over a parked car.
Fifty seven meters. Over the bus he was trying to catch.
Five hundred meters. The bus stop is a dot.
Four and a half kilometers. Next town. Nobody saw anything.
One hundred twenty four kilometers. The beach. He didn't stop.
Three thousand kilometers. Across the ocean. Still holding his coffee.
Ninety thousand kilometers. More than twice around the planet.
He landed right back at the bus stop. The bus was just leaving.
The real part: an average adult step is about seventy centimeters. Walking around the Earth would take about fifty seven million of them.
